authoritative: Source: the Lieutenant Governor's official general election report, whose county rows add up to each candidate's printed state total; they replace Algara and Amlani's county rows.
title: General election report by county, Utah, November 8, 1994

pages.hint: One row per Utah county with its registered voters and number voting, then one column per candidate across the page, in printed order, with the candidate's name as the header; read the votes only, never the percent row, and leave a cell empty when it is blank. Include the TOTAL row. Columns of state legislative races, judges, and other offices may appear: keep them with their printed headers.
